description: This file defines a Perl class for a ResultSet related to 'Tag' in a database schema, including methods for joining, filtering by names, and ungrouped tags.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Tag
classes.description: A Perl class representing a database ResultSet for tags, with methods for joining, filtering by names, and retrieving ungrouped tags.

methods.name: joined
methods.description: Concatenates all 'name' column values into a single space-separated string.

methods.name: from_names
methods.description: Filters tags based on a space-separated string of names.

methods.name: ungrouped
methods.description: Retrieves tags that are not associated with any group.
